gloss: clerical work; office work; administrative tasks

definitions.gloss: clerical work; office work; administrative tasks
definitions.explanation: Routine administrative tasks such as data entry, filing, correspondence, and document preparation. A compound of {事務|じむ} (office affairs; clerical duties) and {作業|さぎょう} (work; tasks).

examples.japanese: {事務作業|じむさぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
{事務作業|じむさぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{効率化|こうりつか}→効率化：07565_kouritsuka⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to make the clerical work more efficient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{事務作業|じむさぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦やっている→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: Since there are many meetings in the morning, I batch my clerical work in the afternoon.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧ (office affairs) and ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (work; tasks). Refers to the routine paperwork and administrative tasks that are part of most office jobs. This is a very common word in Japanese workplaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事務作業|じむさぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われる→追う：02016_ou⟧: to be chased by clerical work; to be swamped with paperwork
- {事務作業|じむさぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{効率化|こうりつか}→効率化：07565_kouritsuka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to streamline clerical work
- {事務作業|じむさぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧: to handle clerical tasks
- ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事務作業|じむさぎょう}: daily office work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧: office work; clerical duties — the shorter, more general term
- デスクワーク: desk work — loanword covering all work done at a desk
- {雑務|ざつむ}: miscellaneous tasks — less structured routine work
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: paperwork — specifically dealing with documents
